QuestInfo.name: A Step Forward
QuestInfo.0:
It has become easier to wield the power of Wu Shen. 
You're happy to see progress being made with your training. You should return to the Xuanshan School and finish before you forget these lessons.
QuestInfo.1: It has become easier to wield the Divine Fist's power, but you know this isn't the end of your journey. You can still become stronger.
